caveat: 这是【当前风险环境的客观描述】——现值在历史的位置 + 体制标签,**绝不预测方向、不构成买卖建议**。如'曲线倒挂与衰退相关'是历史关联的描述,非'会跌'。用 VIX(2000+)/收益率曲线(2000+)/信用利差 Baa-10Y(2000+)/VIX 期限结构(2006+)/个股共动羊群(2004+),均跨 2008、2020。信用维度用穆迪 Baa-10Y(ICE 高收益利差在 FRED 仅~2年,访问受限);羊群=8 只大盘股近60日平均两两相关。

components.name: 波动率 VIX
components.label: 中性
components.note: 股市波动/恐慌水平(现值在历史的分位)
components.note_en: Equity volatility / fear level (where today sits in its own history).

components.name: 收益率曲线 10Y-2Y
components.label: 正斜率偏平
components.note: 期限利差(月频GS10/GS2,日期可能滞后);倒挂在历史上与衰退相关(描述性关联，非方向预测)
components.note_en: Term spread (monthly GS10/GS2, so the date can lag); inversions have historically been associated with recessions (a descriptive association, not a directional forecast).

components.name: 信用利差 Baa-10Y
components.label: 偏低(信用宽松)
components.note: 穆迪 Baa 公司债 减 10Y 国债(信用压力代理);高分位=信用紧张(描述性,非预测)
components.note_en: Moody's Baa corporate yield minus the 10Y Treasury (a proxy for credit stress); a high percentile means tight credit (descriptive, not a forecast).

components.name: VIX 期限结构 (VIX3M-VIX)
components.label: 正常(远月更高)
components.note: 倒挂=近月恐慌高于远月，通常对应急性市场压力(描述当前状态，非预测)
components.note_en: Backwardation means front-month fear exceeds back-month, which usually corresponds to acute market stress (describes the current state, not a forecast).

components.name: 个股共动(羊群)
components.label: 偏低(各走各的)
components.note: 8 只大盘股近 60 日平均两两相关;高=危机式趋同(分散失效)、低=各走各的(描述性,非预测)
components.note_en: Average pairwise correlation of 8 large-cap names over the last 60 days; high = crisis-style convergence (diversification stops working), low = names moving independently (descriptive, not a forecast).

composite: 当前环境：波动率中性 + 曲线正斜率偏平 + 信用利差偏低(信用宽松) + 个股共动偏低(各走各的)。
